name: Credit squeeze
description: As a show's end credits roll, they shrink into a box and the rest of the picture says what's on next (with its picture and time, and what's after it), like network TV. Credits are found from chapters named for them, or Jellyfin's media segments (Jellyfin 10.10+ with a segment provider such as Intro Skipper). Shows' own outros can be squeezed too. Each channel and block sets the odds.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: each squeeze decodes the credits and encodes them again in software, about real time at 720p on a Pi 5 and slower on a Pi 4. Keep 720p and "only for watched channels", and turn the shrinking animation off on channels where squeezes come out late. The encoder and preset are under App settings → Hardware and video encoding.

settings.label: Save folder
settings.description: Where squeezes are made. ErsatzTV must be able to read it.

settings.label: Make squeezes when they air within (minutes)
settings.description: 15 to 2880. Credits play as they are until their squeeze is ready.

settings.label: Only make squeezes for channels someone is watching
settings.description: Uses ErsatzTV's stream activity. Tuning in starts making the channel's squeezes; credits whose squeeze isn't ready in time play as they are.

settings.label: Ask Jellyfin for credits segments
settings.description: Jellyfin 10.10 and newer keep where the credits are (its "Outro" media segments) when a segment provider such as Intro Skipper has found them. Chapters named "Credits" are always used.

settings.label: Squeeze the last seconds of episodes without known credits
settings.description: 0 to 600 seconds; 0 leaves them alone. For shows Jellyfin hasn't found credits for (and with no Credits chapter). A channel or block can set its own in its Credit Squeeze tab.

settings.label: Squeeze resolution
settings.lowPowerNote: Keep 720p here: 1080p is over twice the work for each squeeze.

settings.label: ffmpeg
settings.description: Leave empty to use the ffmpeg set under App settings.

settings.label: Tesseract OCR executable
settings.description: For Credits Text canvas layers. Install Tesseract and its language data; leave empty to find tesseract on PATH. OCR runs locally on the original credits before they are squeezed.

settings.label: Credits OCR languages
settings.description: Installed Tesseract language codes, for example eng or eng+fra. OCR preserves recognized wording; small or stylized text can be misread, so check a preview.

settings.label: OCR quality / speed
settings.description: Fast uses one pass. Balanced uses higher-accuracy models when installed and retries weak frames once. Accurate also tries automatic page segmentation on weak frames. Install accuracy models from the channel's preview controls. Boundary scanning stays single-pass.

settings.label: Read a credits frame every (seconds)
settings.description: 1 to 5 for manually selected segments. Use 1 for scrolling or fast-changing credits. Automatic boundary detection refines and reads its selected credits at one-second intervals. Results are cached per source segment.

settings.label: Search for credits in the last (minutes)
settings.description: 1 to 15. Automatic detection uses a coarse ending scan, then refines a credible interval at one-second precision. Uncertain episodes are left unchanged.
